landing.title: Workplace English for developers, learned by going to work in a game.
landing.subtitle: Standups with the Scrum Master, code reviews with the Tech Lead, bug reports with QA. Five IT words a day, reviewed right before you forget.

npc.title: NPC colleagues
npc.body: Nine international characters — HR, mentor, Scrum Master, QA, Tech Lead, SRE, client — each teaches a work skill.

daily.title: 5 IT words a day
daily.body: Real vocabulary (commit, blocker, rollback…) with Vietnamese meanings, audio and examples.

srs.title: Smart review
srs.body: FSRS spaced repetition reminds you right before you forget, with verification checks.

career.title: Career progression
career.body: Climb from Intern to Tech Lead through promotion interviews with the CTO.
